section_gap_169_9.duty: US-0 assessment_dispute: asymptotic regime of the Student/Neyman route
open_items: No asymptotic statement for Neyman's Example II (triangular law), which has no sample-size index as routed.
Second-order term proved only under normal sampling; no rate for non-normal laws.
Nothing written for laws without finite variance.

bib_intake: comment only; cites DurrettPTEAuthor2019 (already in handbook.bib) at p. 144, Theorem 3.4.1 and p. 147, Exercise 3.4.5
symbol_intake: handbook/registry/symbols-intake-p15-estimation-hypothesis-tests-and-confidence-procedures-w02b-p15-059.csv (z_p, C_k, kappa_nu, G_t, psi, L_n, I_n/J_n, d, delta, B_delta, pi_m, N_n/O_n, beta_n, Pi_n, K_n)
proposed_decisions: C_k (real multiplier subscript) vs C_0 of sec:p15-student-inference (Student central interval): keep both; C_0 there is a fixed name, C_k here is indexed by a multiplier k; the body states that the Student interval is C_k with k=t_{nu,(1+alpha)/2}. Alternative: rename C_k to C^{(k)} if the registry requires disjoint glyphs.
psi(t) here is theorem-local and collides in glyph with Huber's psi score in sec:p15-huber-robust-location; scope is thm:p15-w02b-p15-059-second-order only.
L_n generalizes L of def:p15-neyman-uniform-systems (two-observation maximum).
S_n here is the sample standard deviation (as in def:p15-student-model); def:p15-clt-notation uses S_n for partial sums. The new chapter does not use S_n for partial sums.

delta (practical margin, chapter scope from def:p15-w02b-p15-059-magnitude) also appears as a proof-local positive number in the annex proofs of thm:p15-w02b-p15-059-second-order and thm:p15-w02b-p15-059-uniform-regimes; keep, those uses are bound inside the proofs.
d (departure mu-m) is chapter-local; distinct from Cohen effect size d in P19 records.
Pi_n, u_n, v_n index the posterior of thm:p15-bayes-normal-calculation (its u, v) by n; no new parameterization.
beta_n here is the rejection probability as a function of the standardized departure; theorem-local to thm:p15-w02b-p15-059-scale.
existing_treatments_not_listed: handbook/parts/p15/measurement-uncertainty.tex 490-511 (exact Student procedure mention and Welch-Satterthwaite approximation; no asymptotic regime)

No existing treatment of practical magnitude found in handbook/parts/p15 (searched: practical, negligible, effect size, magnitude, significance). Related but distinct: thm:p15-confidence-credibility-boundary (coverage vs posterior content), thm:p15-bayes-coverage, def:p15-valid-p-value; linked, not duplicated.
